ActiveTaskInfo.description: Display identity of a task that is queued, running, or recently finished.

AiPerfSingleConfigSnapshot.description: Public settings of an AIPerf single load run imported by the service.

AlignmentDimension.description: One comparable dimension with concrete reasons.

AvailabilityState.description: Whether one result surface can be read, with the reason when it cannot.

CacheExperiment.description: Target prefix reuse, independent of generated reuse or observed cache hits.

CacheExperimentConfigSnapshot.description: Public plan identity of a prefix-cache experiment (credentials excluded).

CacheExperimentOutcome.description: Small task result; the experiment manifest contains subrun details.

CacheExperimentPlan.description: A reproducible plan and its request budget.

CacheExperimentSummaryResponse.description: Authoritative, plan-wide experiment counts for the report header.

CacheNodeSeriesResponse.description: Bounded raw node points and their full matching sample count.

CacheObservation.description: Server-reported cache-read token totals and their actual coverage.

CachePlanConfiguration.description: Reproducible configuration without inference or telemetry credentials.

CacheRatioVerification.description:
Declared-versus-observed prefix reuse for one synthetic run.

The declared ratio is a property of the generated workload; only a
server-reported ratio can confirm or refute it. A ratio the server did not
report is ``unavailable``, never an invented deviation, and it only becomes
a data-quality defect when the plan explicitly requires the observation.

CacheRepetitionItem.description: One planned repetition with its independently observed metric.

CacheRequestGroup.description: A group defined only by the server's request-level cached token count.

CacheSubrunPlan.description: One uniquely named, independently seeded matrix member.

ClientProgress.description: AIPerf client counters, distinct from all server node metrics.

ContextCheck.description: One distinct context judgement, exposed so the UI can explain the basis.

DeploymentFacts.description: Declared deployment shape; facts are recorded, never used to reprogram a cluster.

EffectiveIdentity.description:
Execution-time identity, kept apart from the accepted plan hash.

``identity_version`` versions the comparison semantics. A comparison of two
records with different versions, or with unknown content hashes, is
``unknown``: an equal unknown fingerprint never means "matched".

EvalConfigSnapshot.description: Public evaluation settings that are safe to display and copy.

EventType.description: Canonical event kinds emitted by the AgentLoop or external-agent bridge.

ExecutionSubset.description: Completion counts for one evaluated subset.

ExecutionSummary.description: Run completeness kept separate from aggregation-specific metric counts.

ExperimentCoverage.description: Planned / completed / readable subrun counts, kept explicitly distinct.

ExperimentGroup.description: One comparable cell of the experiment matrix (dimensions never merged).

HistogramWindow.description: Window bucket deltas and approximate quantiles, never averaged percentiles.

JudgeSummary.description: First-class summary of a judge session, for reports and offline inspection.

LiveGauge.description: A single unaggregated gauge series from one actual node scrape.

LoadConfiguration.description: Load points and budgets shared by all experiment scenarios.

LoadPoint.description: One closed-loop concurrency or open-loop request rate.

MetricDisplayKind.description: How a metric value is rendered.

MetricKind.description: Whether a metric grades quality or only describes a run.

MetricMapping.description: One exact upstream metric family and its non-aggregated semantics.

MetricStatistics.description: A metric with explicit unit, scope, source, and observation count.

MetricWindow.description: An explicit profiling window in the collector's nanosecond clock.

NativePerfConfigSnapshot.description: Public settings of a native EvalScope performance run (single or sweep).

NodeCacheRatio.description: vLLM lookup-token ratio; never confused with response cache usage.

NodeMetricSample.description: One source-attributed raw sample; no request-level PD inference is made.

NodeMetricSeries.description: Selected raw points, reporting the full matching population and sampling method.

NodeMetricWindow.description: A single node/label series with upstream definition and measured window.

NodeMetricsAnalysis.description: Bounded node analysis and the provenance of its profiling interval.

NodePreflight.description: A single endpoint's reachability and documented matching families.

NodeScrapeSummary.description: Observed successful scrapes; failures are unknown when not exported.

PerfEngineCapability.description: Public availability of a performance execution engine.

PerfEntryListResponse.description: A filtered page of unified performance entries.

PerfInvokeResponse.description: Typed AIPerf task result, compatible with the shared task monitor.

PerfLiveResponse.description: Bounded last node scrapes and the current planned scenario, when available.

PerfPlanArchiveResponse.description: Archived plan provenance, bounded run page and effective runtime identity.

PerfPlanDocument.description: A portable, versioned and credential-free performance plan.

PerfPlanExportResponse.description: A stable, credential-free serialization that can be imported again.

PerfPlanInvokeResponse.description: Terminal result of a synchronous plan execution.

PerfPlanOutcome.description: Small terminal result; per-run details stay in the plan manifest.

PerfPlanPreviewResponse.description: A side-effect-free preview: normalized plan, matrix, budgets, diagnostics and alignment.

PerfPlanResponse.description: A side-effect-free cache experiment plan and its limitations.

PerfPlanRunView.description:
One planned run as requested (dimensions) and as executed (state).

The dimensions come from the accepted plan and the state from the manifest,
so a partially executed matrix shows the real length/concurrency/repetition
of every point instead of the first run's arguments.

PerfPlanSubmitResponse.description:
The truthful acceptance answer for one plan submission.

``state`` is the state of the task this plan already owns, so an accepted
retry never pretends a finished run is still queued.

PerfRequestRecord.description: A request record without inferred server cache data.

PerfRunResult.description: A normalized run; raw files remain the source of truth.

PerfSinglePlanResponse.description: Preflight for one inline-prompt AIPerf run.

PerformanceResultEntry.description: One row of the unified performance result list.

PlanAlignment.description: All comparable dimensions for one plan and the resulting overall status.

PlanBudgets.description: Request and output ceilings, with the one-off phases kept separate.

PlanConfigSnapshot.description:
Public identity and mechanics of a portable performance plan.

Declared deployment facts are labelled as declared; the effective tokenizer
and template hashes come from the archive and stay ``None`` until a run
resolves them.

PlanConnection.description: Where the plan sends requests; never carries a credential.

PlanDiagnosticView.description: One structured diagnostic; never contains prompts, secrets or local paths.

PlanExecution.description: Deterministic ordering of the compiled matrix.

PlanLoad.description: Load axis, request count and output budget shared by every run.

PlanPriming.description: Prefix priming policy, separate from ordinary warmup.

PlanRunSummary.description: Bounded per-run projection of the compiled matrix.

PlanRuntimeIdentity.description: Identity of the runtime/tokenizer/template, explicitly unknown until checked.

PlanTelemetry.description:
Node telemetry stays outside the portable document in this version.

The Web form still supports required node metrics, but a portable plan has
no field that can name a collection target: the target URL and its bearer
token are runtime configuration. Accepting ``required=true`` here would
promise a collection this document cannot describe, so it is rejected
instead of being silently downgraded to ``required=false``.

PlanWarmup.description: Ordinary warmup sent once before the whole matrix; never counted as formal samples.

PlanWarmupState.description: Ordinary warmup outcome, kept out of the formal request counts.

PlannedMetricNode.description: Credential-free identity of a configured telemetry node.

PredictionScore.description: Score fields rendered by the Web UI; metadata remains benchmark-defined.

ProgressResponse.description: Progress tracker payload with stable fields and tracker-specific metadata.

PublicAIPerfOutcome.description: Single-run outcome without local paths or credentials.

ReportGroup.description: One row per model in a `group_by=model` listing - display-only rollup, never a merged report.

RequestLatencyDistribution.description: Exact nearest-rank percentiles for observed request latencies.

ResultAvailability.description: Readability of a task's result as a whole (independent of its quality).

ResultCapabilities.description: Per-surface capability set resolved from the archive, never from the engine label.

ScoreStatus.description:
Whether a score is usable, and why it is not.

A failed judge is not a zero: only ``SUCCESS`` and ``FALLBACK`` carry a score that may
enter aggregation. The remaining values mean the score is unavailable and the sample
must be excluded from the affected metric rather than counted as 0.

SyntheticCase.description: One explicit shared-system / unique-user split copied from a legacy script.

SyntheticWorkload.description: AIPerf synthetic compatibility workload: system + user messages, not one user blob.

TaskDetailResponse.description: Task detail: the list projection plus the sanitized configuration snapshot.

TaskIndexingState.description: How much of the output root the persistent index has discovered.

TaskListResponse.description: A filtered page of tasks plus the scope it was read from.

TaskSubmitResponse.description: Acknowledgement that a task was accepted for background execution.

TaskSummaryItem.description: One task as shown in the Task Center list or used for detail headers.

TaskSummaryResponse.description: Global task counts; never derived from a single page of list items.

TokenPrefixWorkload.description: Managed token-prefix workload: a target reuse ratio per input length.

TokenizerIdentity.description: What was actually resolved, never what a path suggests.

TraceUsage.description: Mirrors `evalscope.api.model.model_output.ModelUsage`'s shape for the response contract.

WarmupConfiguration.description: Synthetic pre-run traffic sent once before a cache experiment matrix.

WindowStatistic.description: A window value with coverage and explicit boundary semantics.

description: Schema-only root that keeps every public Web API type reachable for code generation.
